With hvv switch, you have hvv, car sharing, ridesharing and scooter sharing in one app. Buy tickets for bus, train and ferry or rent a car from SIXT share or MILES. Alternatively, you can call a MOIA shuttle or explore Hamburg flexibly with an e-scooter from TIER or Voi. For unlimited mobility on public transport, you can order the hvv Deutschlandticket and pay for it in the app. 

The best features of hvv switch: 

• Public transport, car sharing, ridesharing, and scooter sharing in one app 
• Order the hvv Deutschlandticket & other hvv tickets 
• NEW: Enjoy automatic ticket purchase with hvv Any 
• Use the hvv connection info as a route planner 
• Rent a car from Sixt share or MILES 
• Book a MOIA shuttle 
• Rent an e-scooter from TIER or Voi 
• Pay securely with PayPal, credit card or SEPA 

6 mobility providers – one app 
hvv switch combines Hamburg's public transport with the mobility offers of MOIA, SIXT share, MILES, TIER, and Voi. Missed your train or bus? Just switch to ride or car sharing! 
 
Order the hvv Deutschlandticket 
With hvv switch you always have your hvv Deutschlandticket with you. The mobile ticket is a personal non-transferable monthly subscription and currently costs 49 € per month. With the hvv Deutschlandticket, you can use all of the public transport in Germany, including regional transport. Handy - your hvv Deutschlandticket is displayed on the start screen of the hvv switch app. 
 
Order a mobile ticket & pay conveniently 
Buy tickets for Hamburg's public transport - from short journey tickets to single tickets and 9 am group tickets. You can pay securely and quickly with PayPal, SEPA direct debit, or credit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express). 
 
NEW: hvv Any – the smart ticket 
hvv Any is your companion on the hvv system that knows all the fares and books the cheapest ticket for you. Just let the app know when you get on and it will know when you change and automatically complete your journey when you get off. At the end, it adds up all your journeys for the day and finds the best ticket for you - you always pay the best price. For hvv Any to recognise your journeys, you need to enable Bluetooth, location sharing and motion detection. 

Timetable information 
You know your destination, but not the route? Then use the timetable information as a route planner for bus and train: 
 
• Display the route by clicking on the line symbol 
• Add connections to your calendar & share them with contacts 
• Add a stopover to a route 
• Find departures near you or for any stop 
 
MILES – car sharing  
With hvv switch, you can use the MILES car sharing service and conveniently rent an electric car. The trips with MILES Carsharing are billed by the kilometre. You can charge the cars at our hvv switch points. 
 
SIXT share – car sharing 
With SIXT share, we have a second car sharing partner on board. The trips with SIXT share are paid for by the minute and billed directly to your hvv switch account. You can find SIXT share vehicles in the app and at hvv switch points. 
 
TIER e-scooter 
For even more mobility, you can also rent TIER e-scooters. Find a scooter easily and unlock it with just a few clicks in the app. Grab a TIER scooter right now and try it out! 

Voi e-scooter 
With hvv switch you can also rent e-scooters from Voi. Rent a scooter and explore Hamburg up close. Our app shows all e-scooters in your area. Be flexible on the road with a scooter from Voi. 

MOIA – ridesharing 
With the electric fleet of MOIA, you can reach your destination in a climate-friendly way. Share the ride with up to 4 people and save money! You book a ride, get on the shuttle and passengers get on or off during the journey. With MOIA’s ridesharing service, you free up Hamburg's roads and also help out the environment. 

Feedback 
Your opinion makes the hvv switch app better. Write us your thoughts to info@hvv-switch.de
